purpose: Single source of truth for every registered AI-delivery producer-format adapter: its fingerprint, implementation, hash evidence, status, and the deliveries it has been run against. Governed by the Producer Delivery Adapter Contract and Onboarding Procedure in AI-Solution-Output-Validation-Plan.md (Phase 5) and control AIV-027 in AI-ARTIFACT-VALIDATION-CONTROLS.md. An unregistered, one-off script run against a new or changed AI-delivery shape is informal evidence only and must not be cited as a certified adapter.

statusDefinitions.PROVISIONAL: Adapter mechanically parses and normalizes the producer format correctly (structural evidence only). SME/TBA has not reviewed the resulting crosswalk/coverage disposition. Never cite PROVISIONAL output as CONFIRMED semantic coverage.
statusDefinitions.SME_REVIEWED: An SME/TBA (or formally delegated approver) has reviewed a representative sample of this adapter's output and confirmed the field mapping is correct.
statusDefinitions.DEPRECATED: Format is no longer produced by the AI team; adapter retained for historical/regression reference only.

fingerprint.description: A single nested traceability JSON file (spec/version + requirements/scenarios/cases/testData nested graph) plus a sibling payload/metadata folder.
keyIndicators: Top-level traceability JSON with 'spec' and nested requirement->scenario->testCase->testData graph
Payload files named '<TC-id>-...' or '<TC-id>.json' alongside the traceability file

adapters.notes: Established adapter; predates this registry. Listed here to make the registry a complete inventory, not because it changed on 2026-11-12.

adapters.displayName: 5-10 per-network delivery shape (Nov 2026, all 5 payment-network packages)

fingerprint.description: One folder per network (e.g. american_express_credit/, mastercard_credit/, mastercard_fleet/, interlink_debit/, maestro_direct_debit/), each containing DELIVERY_CONTRACT.md, MANIFEST.json, run_set.json, requirements_scenarios/, test_cases/, test_data/.
keyIndicators: requirements_scenarios/business_requirements.json with top-level keys {meta, business_requirements} and exactly one umbrella record per network

requirements_scenarios/business_scenarios.csv with columns including message,conditions,gaps,scenario,status,requires_sme,supporting_rules_requiring_review (the last is a count, not text, despite its name)
test_cases/test_cases.jsonl: one JSON object per line per test case, with segment_decisions.<segment>.kb_rule_ids, response_checks[].rule_id, rule_checks[], scenario_rule_references
test_data/*.json: one request JSON per test case; flow legs named TD-<TC>.step<n>.<leg>.json; Segment 102 identified by SegmentType=="102" with a ProductCode field

implementation.location: Session workspace (not yet ported to src/main/java/com/coreauth/validator/coverage); candidate target package: com.coreauth.validator.coverage.FiveTenDeliveryAdapter

files.name: extract_br_coverage.py
files.purpose: Extracts per-network Test BR catalog (scenario_supporting_rules.csv) + scenario/TC status counts + gate metadata into a single combined dataset.

files.name: crosswalk_engine.py
files.purpose: IDF-weighted token-overlap + numeric/section-anchor matching engine crosswalking the 1,343-row independent Test Solution BR catalog against this format's 2,755 AI rule statements.

files.name: appf_validator.py
files.purpose: Presence/value validator: joins BR-APPF-ROW-NNN Test BRs to the existing AppendixFProductCodeOracle and checks delivered test_data for actual Segment 102 ProductCode occurrences.

files.name: mine_segment_anchors.py
files.purpose: Mines test_cases.jsonl segment_decisions.<segment>.kb_rule_ids across all networks into a rule_id -> ATL105 segment anchor map.

implementation.testEvidence: None yet. Add a regression test fixture (a small synthetic 5-10-shaped sample delivery with a known expected crosswalk result) before this adapter may move to SME_REVIEWED.

sourceHashEvidence.description: Per-file SHA-256 for every file in the analyzed delivery is already captured by the independent delivery-gate run; this adapter cites that manifest instead of recomputing hashes.

adapters.notes: Confirmed-correct and confirmed-false-positive example matches are documented directly in INDEPENDENT-1343-BR-CROSSWALK-5-10-DELIVERY.html's 'Known limitations' section. Do not promote this adapter to SME_REVIEWED without an SME/TBA sampling the crosswalk's STRONG/SEMANTIC_CANDIDATE tier rows, since the engine has a demonstrated false-positive failure mode on short Test BR statements.
